regime_context: Canada/TSX shows a broad, half-eligible rotation (8/16 themes) led by Gold Miners with a healthy margin over Silver & Royalties. The absolute-trend gate is validated for this market (gate_helps=true), but the macro backdrop is 100% unscheduled headlines and the track record shows directional accuracy of only 0.375, so conviction defaults low despite a solid hit rate.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Utilities & Renewables (currently rank 11, eligible=false, crowding_z -0.97) or Telecom (rank 15, crowding_z -1.42) regains eligibility by crossing back above their durability bars — a confirmed trend-gate re-entry in either defensive theme would signal a broad risk-off handoff from the metals complex. No call until that eligibility flip is confirmed.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners lead with the strongest eligible rank (1.623) and a mid-range durability bar (0.53) with positive breadth (0.533), suggesting the leadership is not a one-stock story. The trend-gate leg is the only validated edge, so any lean here is a stay-with-the-trend call, not a momentum-alpha bet.
evidence: gate_helps=true (absolute-trend discipline validated for this market)
theses.dissent: Gold Miners carries hurst_tag 'mean-revert', so the leadership may be prone to sharp give-backs rather than trending continuation, and the headline r10 is negative (-0.0082).

falsifier.text: XGD.TO closes below its own 20-day moving average while the S&P/TSX stays flat or rises over the next 15 trading days

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver is the confirmed challenger, rank 2 and eligible, and the rotation margin over Gold is a manageable 0.3 with absorption still low (0.31), suggesting the leadership is not yet over-concentrated. A modest overweight reflects staying with the precious-metals cluster rather than a standalone silver-alpha view.
evidence: rotation challenger with margin 0.3 to Gold Miners
theses.dissent: Durability is lower than Gold (0.47) and breadth is weaker (0.417), so this theme may roll over first if the precious-metals complex cools.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties' proxy (XGD.TO tracked against a pure silver exposure) lags Gold Miners by more than 4% over any consecutive 10 trading days during the horizon window

theses.subject: REITs
theses.thesis: REITs sit near the bottom of the eligible/rank board (score -1.083, rank 14) and are ineligible under the absolute-trend gate. Since the gate is the one validated risk-control leg, staying away from the weakest trend-health names is the disciplined default rather than a return-forecasting short.
evidence: durability_bar 0.36 with breadth 0.083 (narrow, weak trend health)
gate_helps=true (absence from the eligible set is itself the signal)
theses.dissent: REITs have a hurst_tag of 'trend' and crowding_z of -1.2 (deeply uncrowded), so a sharp macro shift (e.g., a dovish monetary surprise) could cause a fast mean-reversion bounce that this underweight would miss.

falsifier.text: XRE.TO closes above its 50-day moving average and the S&P/TSX REIT subgroup posts a positive 5-day relative return against the benchmark within the horizon
